label: Sprint Retrospective Facilitator
description: Prepares and structures sprint retrospectives. Analyzes what went well/poorly, facilitates root cause analysis on blockers, and generates prioritized improvement actions.

claudeKnowledge.description: Agile retrospective techniques, root cause analysis, team improvement frameworks, Scrum retrospective formats

guidedInputs.label: Sprint outcome
guidedInputs.placeholder:
How did the sprint go? What was committed vs. completed?
e.g. Committed: 45 SP | Completed: 38 SP | Carryover: US-165 (email notifications, 13 SP) partially complete. Sprint goal achieved (SSO login working in staging). One bug found in production during sprint.

guidedInputs.label: What went well
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List observations, themes, or specific events that were positive this sprint.
e.g.
- Pair programming on US-142 resolved auth bug faster than expected
- Daily standups more focused since we limited to 15 min
- Clear acceptance criteria on BUG-089 made QA fast
- Good collaboration with design team on US-161

guidedInputs.label: What did not go well / blockers
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List problems, friction, blockers, or patterns that slowed the team.
e.g.
- Email notification story (US-165) underestimated — 13 SP was too small
- Backend environment down for half a day on Wednesday — no incident process
- Code review taking 2-3 days — blocking frontend from merging
- Unclear requirements on admin screen caused 2 rework cycles

guidedInputs.label: Previous retrospective actions
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List improvement actions from the previous retrospective and their status — to assess whether improvements took effect.
e.g.
- Action: Create PR template (Done ✓)
- Action: Add environment health check to Definition of Done (Not started)
- Action: Weekly refinement session added (Partially done — 1 of 2 sessions held)
